decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the First Mint replacement, icon uniqueness, sapling icon, and removal of the superseded approved catalog; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Replacing a badge with a First Referral badge does not change ticket allocation for mints performed without referral codes.
The badge awarded for a first referral does not alter prize-ticket issuance, recipients, quantities, or ticket cycles for referral mints.
The badge catalog and trigger change does not modify the Big Block prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility window, or post-draw behavior.
The requirement to expose permanent badges in metadata remains valid unchanged; the specific badge catalog replacement is already owned by the badge presentation requirement.
Introducing a First Referral badge does not change the referral commission amount or automatic payout mode.
The badge replacement does not change Small Block or Big Block ticket counters or their reset semantics.
The First Referral badge decision does not modify the Small Block prize amount, draw target, eligibility window, or ticket reset behavior.
The badge trigger and presentation changes do not alter random ticket-weighted winner selection.
The badge catalog decision does not change the required network or deployment behavior.
The First Referral badge does not change manual prize claiming or prize delivery.
The badge replacement and icon decisions do not affect secondary-sale royalty enforcement.
